svg.title: Tarankan Exim — Continuous Quality Inspection Journey
svg.desc: A tall responsive quality inspection journey from Specification Verification to Pre-Dispatch Inspection, with a moving arrow that draws the route as it advances. Three to four checkpoints remain in view.

g.text: Materials, grades and certificates are checked
points are measured using suitable calibrated
Surface finish, welding, machining and visible
workmanship are examined for defects and
are tested for function, movement, fit and
Packed and loose quantities are counted and
reconciled against the order, packing list and
Before dispatch, cargo is checked for damage,
Product, carton and shipment markings are
checked for correctness, readability and buyer
Final inspection confirms the shipment meets
agreed quality requirements before it leaves
